name: Folio for Paperless
subtitle: Your Paperless-ngx companion
shortDescription: Scan, find, and manage documents on your own Paperless-ngx server.
fullDescription: Folio for Paperless is a mobile client for the Paperless-ngx server you control. Capture paper documents, review your inbox, search your library, and follow processing tasks from a focused mobile interface. Profiles keep server connections separate, and platform integrations are designed to avoid exposing document or server details while the app is locked. A Paperless-ngx server is required.
promotionalText: A private, profile-aware mobile companion for the Paperless-ngx server you control.
